topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package arrived unannounced, wrapped in paper that crinkled like autumn leaves underfoot. I hesitated, fingers brushing the unfamiliar script on the label. Opening it, I found a book, its cover worn and breathed into, a life shared between its pages. A note slipped out, the handwriting looping like memories of a day long past. It spoke of the words I’d shared, the quiet moments of encouragement that had somehow taken root. The room around me faded as I turned the pages, each one a testament to the unseen threads we weave. In the silence, there was a new warmth, a connection that spanned the distance and the years, reminding me of the paths our words can pave, even when the echoes seem lost to time.
